```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(systemfonts) 
library(knitr)

base_colors <- c(
  "#0173B2", "#DE8F05", "#029E73", "#CC78BC",
  "#CA9161", "#949494", "#ECE133", "#56B4E9"
)

base_theme <- function(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, color = "gray30", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", color = "black")
    )
}

theme_set(base_theme())

scale_colour_discrete <- function(...) scale_colour_manual(values = base_colors, ...)
scale_fill_discrete <- function(...) scale_fill_manual(values = base_colors, ...)

# 3. Load Data
dat_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")),
    OA = factor(OA, levels = c("Not OA", "OA")),
    fund = factor(fund, levels = c("Not funded", "Funded")),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                               levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other")),
    collab_type = factor(collab_type, 
                        levels = c("VN-dominated", "Balanced", "JP-dominated", "Other")),
    leadership_label = case_when(
      vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
      jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
      TRUE ~ "Other-led"
    ),
    leadership_label = factor(leadership_label, levels = c("VN-led", "JP-led", "Other-led"))
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    n_authors = str_count(affiliations, ";") + 1,
    n_countries = if("n_countries" %in% names(read.csv("data/processed_data.csv"))) n_countries else 2,
    coop = if("coop" %in% names(read.csv("data/processed_data.csv"))) coop else ifelse(n_countries > 2, "multilateral", "bilateral"),
    is_hyperauthored = n_authors > 50 | n_countries > 10,
    collab_mode = case_when(
      is_hyperauthored ~ "Hyper-authored",
      coop %in% c("bilateral", "Strict Bilateral") ~ "Bilateral",
      TRUE ~ "Multilateral"
    ),
    collab_mode = factor(collab_mode, levels = c("Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyper-authored"))
  )

dat_core <- dat_reg |> filter(collab_mode != "Hyper-authored")
```

```{r}
#| label: table-top-subjects-sensitivity-clean
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

subject_mapping <- c(
  "agr_bio" = "Agricultural and Biological Sciences",
  "arts"    = "Arts and Humanities",
  "bioch"   = "Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology",
  "bus"     = "Business, Management and Accounting",
  "chem"    = "Chemistry",
  "comp"    = "Computer Science",
  "deci"    = "Decision Sciences",
  "dent"    = "Dentistry",
  "earth"   = "Earth and Planetary Sciences",
  "econ"    = "Economics, Econometrics and Finance",
  "ener"    = "Energy",
  "engi"    = "Engineering",
  "env"     = "Environmental Science",
  "heal"    = "Health Professions",
  "immu"    = "Immunology and Microbiology",
  "mate"    = "Materials Science",
  "math"    = "Mathematics",
  "medi"    = "Medicine",
  "neur"    = "Neuroscience",
  "nurs"    = "Nursing",
  "phar"    = "Pharmacology, Toxicology and Pharmaceutics",
  "phys"    = "Physics and Astronomy",
  "psyc"    = "Psychology",
  "soci"    = "Social Sciences",
  "vete"    = "Veterinary",
  "mult"    = "Multidisciplinary"
)

calc_subjects <- function(data, label_suffix) {
  data |> 
    select(any_of(names(subject_mapping))) |> 
    summarise(across(everything(), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) |> 
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Abbr", values_to = paste0("n_", label_suffix)) |> 
    mutate(
      Subject = subject_mapping[Abbr],
      !!paste0("share_", label_suffix) := get(paste0("n_", label_suffix)) / nrow(data)
    ) |> 
    select(Subject, starts_with("n_"), starts_with("share_"))
}

subjects_clean <- calc_subjects(dat_core, "clean")
subjects_total <- calc_subjects(dat_reg, "total")

final_subjects <- subjects_clean |> 
  arrange(desc(n_clean)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 10) |> 
  left_join(subjects_total, by = "Subject") |> 
  select(Subject, n_clean, share_clean, n_total, share_total) |> 
  kable()

final_subjects
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-collab-mode-trends
#| fig.cap: "Publication trends by collaboration mode with annual growth rate (2000-2024)."
#| warning: false

annual_mode_counts <- dat_reg |> 
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2024) |> 
  filter(collab_mode %in% c("Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyper-authored")) |>
  count(year, collab_mode) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  mutate(total_n = sum(n)) |> 
  ungroup()

annual_growth <- annual_mode_counts |> 
  distinct(year, total_n) |> 
  arrange(year) |> 
  mutate(growth = total_n / lag(total_n) - 1) |> 
  mutate(growth = replace_na(growth, 0)) # Handle first year NA

max_n <- max(annual_mode_counts$total_n)
scale_factor <- max_n 

ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = annual_mode_counts, 
    aes(x = year, y = n, fill = collab_mode),
    width = 0.85, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = annual_growth,
    aes(x = year, y = growth * scale_factor),
    color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = annual_growth,
    aes(x = year, y = total_n, label = total_n),
    vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5, color = "gray20"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2009, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 2009, y = max_n * 0.95, 
           label = "2009 Strategic\nPartnership", 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "gray30", lineheight = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2014, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 2014, y = max_n * 0.95, 
           label = "2014 Extensive\nStrategic Partnership", 
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "gray30", lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bilateral" = "#0173B2", "Multilateral" = "#DE8F05", "Hyper-authored" = "#029E73"),
    name = "collaboration_mode"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of publications",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)), # Add space at top for labels
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Year-on-year growth (%)", labels = percent)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 5)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#E85D75"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "#E85D75"),
    axis.line.y.right = element_line(color = "#E85D75"),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(color = "#E85D75")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-disciplinary-composition
#| fig.cap: "Disciplinary composition over time: Absolute volume (A) and Relative share (B)."
#| warning: false

# 1. Prepare Data
macro_trends <- dat_reg |> 
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2024) |> 
  select(year, LS, PS, HS, SS) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(
    `Life Sciences` = sum(LS, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Physical Sciences` = sum(PS, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Health Sciences` = sum(HS, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Social Sciences` = sum(SS, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "Macro_Area", values_to = "n") |> 
  mutate(
    Macro_Area = factor(Macro_Area, levels = c("Physical Sciences", "Life Sciences", "Health Sciences", "Social Sciences"))
  )

# 2. Plot A: Absolute Volume (Stacked) - Softened Alpha
p1 <- ggplot(macro_trends, aes(x = year, y = n, fill = Macro_Area)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Physical Sciences" = "#0173B2", "Life Sciences" = "#029E73", 
               "Health Sciences" = "#DE8F05", "Social Sciences" = "#CC78BC")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(big.mark = ","), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of publications"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# 3. Plot B: Relative Share (100% Stacked) - Softened Alpha
p2 <- ggplot(macro_trends, aes(x = year, y = n, fill = Macro_Area)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill", alpha = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Physical Sciences" = "#0173B2", "Life Sciences" = "#029E73", 
               "Health Sciences" = "#DE8F05", "Social Sciences" = "#CC78BC")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Relative Disciplinary Share",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Share of publications",
    fill = "Macro-area"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: table-equity-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# 1. Calculate Statistics by Mode
stats_by_mode <- dat_core |> 
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_Prop_VN = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Prop_VN = median(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    Balanced = mean(prop_vn_authors >= 0.4 & prop_vn_authors <= 0.6, na.rm = TRUE),
    VN_Majority = mean(prop_vn_authors > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  rename(Mode = collaboration_mode)

# 2. Calculate Total Statistics
stats_total <- dat_core |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_Prop_VN = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Prop_VN = median(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    Balanced = mean(prop_vn_authors >= 0.4 & prop_vn_authors <= 0.6, na.rm = TRUE),
    VN_Majority = mean(prop_vn_authors > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  mutate(Mode = "Total")

# 3. Combine and Format
table_4_2_1 <- bind_rows(stats_by_mode, stats_total) |> 
  filter(Mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Total")) |> 
  mutate(
    Mode = case_when(
      Mode == "Strict Bilateral" ~ "Bilateral",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Mode)
    ),
    Mode = factor(Mode, levels = c("Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Total"))
  ) |> 
  arrange(Mode) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(
    title = "Overall Authorship Equity Summary by Collaboration Mode"
  ) |> 
  cols_label(
    Mode = "Collaboration Mode",
    n = "N",
    Mean_Prop_VN = "Mean Prop VN",
    Median_Prop_VN = "Median Prop VN",
    SD = "SD",
    Balanced = "% Balanced (0.4-0.6)",
    VN_Majority = "% VN Majority (>0.5)"
  ) |> 
  fmt_integer(columns = n) |> 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Mean_Prop_VN, Median_Prop_VN, SD),
    decimals = 3
  ) |> 
  fmt_percent(
    columns = c(Balanced, VN_Majority),
    decimals = 1
  ) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    heading.title.font.size = 12,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )

table_4_2_1
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-vn-prop-trends-with-trend
#| fig.cap: "Mean Vietnamese author proportion over time (2000-2024) with smoothed trend line."
#| warning: false

# 1. Prepare Data
vn_prop_trends <- data_core |> 
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2024) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    ci_lower = mean_prop - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean_prop + 1.96 * se
  )

# 2. Plot
ggplot(vn_prop_trends, aes(x = year, y = mean_prop)) +
  # Reference line for parity (0.5)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 2000, y = 0.51, label = "Parity (0.5)", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3, color = "gray40", fontface = "italic") +
  
  # Confidence Interval Band
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#0173B2", alpha = 0.15) +
  
  # Annual Means (connected line - lighter)
  geom_line(color = "#0173B2", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(color = "#0173B2", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Trend Line (Smoothed - stronger)
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#DE8F05", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Scales and Labels
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0.25, 0.55)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Proportion of Vietnamese Authors"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: table-collab-balance-dist-fixed
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# 1. Prepare Data
# Using dat_reg and standardizing 'Strict Bilateral' to 'Bilateral'
balance_dist <- dat_reg |> 
  filter(collaboration_mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral")) |> 
  mutate(
    Mode = if_else(collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral", "Bilateral", "Multilateral"),
    # Ensure correct factor levels for Balance Categories
    collab_type = factor(collab_type, levels = c("Balanced", "JP-dominated", "VN-dominated", "Other"))
  ) |> 
  group_by(Mode, collab_type) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |> 
  ungroup()

# 2. Reshape for Table
balance_wide <- balance_dist |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Mode,
    values_from = c(n, pct),
    values_fill = list(n = 0, pct = 0)
  )

# 3. Calculate Totals
total_row <- dat_reg |> 
  filter(collaboration_mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral")) |> 
  mutate(
    Mode = if_else(collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral", "Bilateral", "Multilateral")
  ) |> 
  group_by(Mode) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(pct = 1.0) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Mode,
    values_from = c(n, pct)
  ) |> 
  mutate(collab_type = "Total")

# 4. Generate GT Table
table_4_2_4 <- bind_rows(balance_wide, total_row) |> 
  mutate(
    collab_type = factor(collab_type, levels = c("Balanced", "JP-dominated", "VN-dominated", "Other", "Total"))
  ) |> 
  arrange(collab_type) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(
    title = "Distribution of Collaboration Balance Categories"
  ) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Bilateral",
    columns = c(n_Bilateral, pct_Bilateral)
  ) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Multilateral",
    columns = c(n_Multilateral, pct_Multilateral)
  ) |> 
  cols_label(
    collab_type = "Balance Category",
    n_Bilateral = "n",
    pct_Bilateral = "%",
    n_Multilateral = "n",
    pct_Multilateral = "%"
  ) |> 
  fmt_integer(columns = starts_with("n_")) |> 
  fmt_percent(columns = starts_with("pct_"), decimals = 1) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(rows = collab_type == "Total")
  ) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    heading.title.font.size = 12,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )

table_4_2_4
```

```{r}
#| label: table-equity-context
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# 1. Define Funding Categories
data_core <- data_core |> 
  mutate(
    funding_cat = case_when(
      fund == "Not funded" ~ "Unfunded",
      jap == 1 & vn == 1 ~ "Bilateral co-funded",
      jap == 1 ~ "Japan only",
      vn == 1 ~ "Vietnam only",
      fund == "Funded" ~ "Other funding",
      TRUE ~ "Unfunded"
    ),
    funding_cat = factor(funding_cat, levels = c("Bilateral co-funded", "Japan only", "Vietnam only", "Other funding", "Unfunded"))
  )

# 2. Function to Calculate Equity Stats
calc_equity_stats <- function(data, group_col, section_name) {
  data |> 
    group_by({{ group_col }}) |> 
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      Mean_Prop_VN = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
      VN_Led = mean(vn_led == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Balanced = mean(collab_type == "Balanced", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    rename(Category = {{ group_col }}) |> 
    mutate(Category = as.character(Category), Section = section_name)
}

# 3. Calculate for Each Section
# Journal Quartile (Exclude NA)
stats_quartile <- data_core |> 
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |> 
  calc_equity_stats(quartile, "Journal Quality")

# Funding Configuration
stats_funding <- data_core |> 
  calc_equity_stats(funding_cat, "Funding Configuration")

# Total Row
stats_total <- data_core |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_Prop_VN = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    VN_Led = mean(vn_led == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Balanced = mean(collab_type == "Balanced", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  mutate(Category = "Total", Section = "Total")

# 4. Combine and Generate GT Table
table_equity_context <- bind_rows(stats_quartile, stats_funding, stats_total) |> 
  # Set row order (Quartile first, then Funding, then Total)
  mutate(Section = factor(Section, levels = c("Journal Quality", "Funding Configuration", "Total"))) |> 
  group_by(Section) |> 
  gt(rowname_col = "Category") |> 
  tab_header(
    title = "Authorship Equity by Journal Quality and Funding Configuration"
  ) |> 
  cols_label(
    n = "N",
    Mean_Prop_VN = "Mean Prop VN",
    VN_Led = "% VN-led",
    Balanced = "% Balanced"
  ) |> 
  fmt_integer(columns = n) |> 
  fmt_number(columns = Mean_Prop_VN, decimals = 3) |> 
  fmt_percent(columns = c(VN_Led, Balanced), decimals = 1) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Category == "Total")
  ) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    heading.title.font.size = 12,
    row_group.font.weight = "bold"
  )

table_equity_context
```

```{r}
  annotate("text", x = 2000, y = 1.05, label = "Parity (Equal Impact)", 
           hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "gray40", fontface = "italic") +
  
  # The Data Line (Distance from Equality)
  geom_line(color = "#0173B2", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = parity_ratio >= 1), size = 2) +
  
  # Fill area to show the gap
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = parity_ratio, ymax = 1, fill = parity_ratio >= 1), alpha = 0.2) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Relative Median Citation Impact (VN / JP)",
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    limits = c(0, NA)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#DE8F05", "TRUE" = "#0173B2"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#DE8F05", "TRUE" = "#0173B2"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 4)) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    subtitle = "Values < 1 indicate VN-led papers have lower median citations than JP-led papers"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: table-citation-tiers
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# 1. Define Citation Tiers
tier_data <- data_core |> 
  filter(collab_mode %in% c("Bilateral", "Multilateral")) |> 
  mutate(
    Citation_Tier = case_when(
      cited == 0 ~ "Zero (0)",
      cited >= 1 & cited <= 10 ~ "Low (1–10)",
      cited >= 11 & cited <= 50 ~ "Medium (11–50)",
      cited >= 51 & cited <= 100 ~ "High (51–100)",
      cited > 100 ~ "Very High (>100)"
    ),
    # Set factor levels to ensure correct ordering in table
    Citation_Tier = factor(Citation_Tier, 
                           levels = c("Zero (0)", "Low (1–10)", "Medium (11–50)", 
                                      "High (51–100)", "Very High (>100)"))
  )

# 2. Calculate Counts and Percentages
tier_summary <- tier_data |> 
  group_by(collab_mode, Citation_Tier) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |> 
  ungroup()

# 3. Reshape for Table
tier_wide <- tier_summary |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = collab_mode,
    values_from = c(n, pct),
    values_fill = list(n = 0, pct = 0)
  )

# 4. Calculate Totals
total_row <- tier_data |> 
  group_by(collab_mode) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(pct = 1.0) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = collab_mode,
    values_from = c(n, pct)
  ) |> 
  mutate(Citation_Tier = "Total")

# 5. Generate GT Table
table_4_3_3 <- bind_rows(tier_wide, total_row) |> 
  # Ensure Total is last (though it naturally falls there if not a factor level)
  mutate(Citation_Tier = as.character(Citation_Tier)) |> 
  mutate(Citation_Tier = factor(Citation_Tier, 
                                levels = c("Zero (0)", "Low (1–10)", "Medium (11–50)", 
                                           "High (51–100)", "Very High (>100)", "Total"))) |> 
  arrange(Citation_Tier) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(
    title = "Citation Impact Tiers by Collaboration Mode"
  ) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Bilateral",
    columns = c(n_Bilateral, pct_Bilateral)
  ) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Multilateral",
    columns = c(n_Multilateral, pct_Multilateral)
  ) |> 
  cols_label(
    Citation_Tier = "Impact Tier",
    n_Bilateral = "n",
    pct_Bilateral = "%",
    n_Multilateral = "n",
    pct_Multilateral = "%"
  ) |> 
  fmt_integer(columns = starts_with("n_")) |> 
  fmt_percent(columns = starts_with("pct_"), decimals = 1) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Citation_Tier == "Total")
  ) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    heading.title.font.size = 12,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: table-regression-fixed-2
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# 1. Load Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(broom)
library(gt)

# 2. ROBUST DATA PREPARATION
reg_data <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |> 
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Hyperauthored") |> 
  mutate(
    collab_mode = case_when(
      collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral" ~ "Bilateral",
      collaboration_mode == "Multilateral" ~ "Multilateral",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    leadership_label = case_when(
      vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
      jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
      TRUE ~ "Other-led"
    ),
    macro_area = case_when(
      HS == 1 ~ "Health Sciences",
      LS == 1 ~ "Life Sciences",
      PS == 1 ~ "Physical Sciences",
      SS == 1 ~ "Social Sciences",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    macro_area = factor(macro_area, levels = c("Health Sciences", "Life Sciences", "Physical Sciences", "Social Sciences", "Other")),
    is_multilateral = if_else(collab_mode == "Multilateral", 1, 0),
    is_funded = if_else(fund == "Funded", 1, 0),
    is_Q1 = if_else(quartile == "Q1", 1, 0),
    is_OA = if_else(OA == "OA", 1, 0),
    prop_vn_centered = prop_vn_authors - mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    year_num = year - 2000
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(macro_area), !is.na(cited), !is.na(quartile))

# 3. FIT MODELS
m1 <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led + jp_led + year_num + macro_area, data = reg_data)
m2 <- update(m1, . ~ . + is_multilateral + prop_vn_centered)
m3 <- update(m2, . ~ . + is_funded + is_Q1 + is_OA)
m4 <- update(m3, . ~ . + vn_led:is_funded + vn_led:is_Q1 + vn_led:year_num)

# 4. EXTRACT RESULTS (Fixed dplyr conflict)
extract_model_stats <- function(model, name) {
  # Extract coefficients
  coefs <- tidy(model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = FALSE) |> 
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, p.value) |> 
    mutate(
      stars = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        p.value < 0.1 ~ ".",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      formatted = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", estimate), stars)
    ) |> 
    dplyr::select(term, formatted) |> 
    rename(!!name := formatted)
  
  # Extract fit statistics
  stats <- tibble(
    term = c("n", "AIC", "BIC"),
    formatted = c(
      format(nobs(model), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(AIC(model)), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(BIC(model)), big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) |> 
    rename(!!name := formatted)
  
  bind_rows(coefs, stats)
}

res_m1 <- extract_model_stats(m1, "M1 (Baseline)")
res_m2 <- extract_model_stats(m2, "M2 (Structure)")
res_m3 <- extract_model_stats(m3, "M3 (Resources)")
res_m4 <- extract_model_stats(m4, "M4 (Interactions)")

reg_table_data <- res_m1 |> 
  full_join(res_m2, by = "term") |> 
  full_join(res_m3, by = "term") |> 
  full_join(res_m4, by = "term")

# 5. GENERATE TABLE
term_mapping <- c(
  "vn_led" = "VN-led",
  "jp_led" = "JP-led",
  "is_multilateral" = "Multilateral",
  "prop_vn_centered" = "Prop VN (centered)",
  "is_funded" = "Funded",
  "is_Q1" = "Q1 Journal",
  "is_OA" = "OA",
  "vn_led:is_funded" = "VN-led × Funded",
  "vn_led:is_Q1" = "VN-led × Q1",
  "vn_led:year_num" = "VN-led × Year",
  "n" = "n", "AIC" = "AIC", "BIC" = "BIC"
)

table_4_3_4 <- reg_table_data |> 
  filter(term %in% names(term_mapping)) |> 
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = names(term_mapping), labels = term_mapping)) |> 
  arrange(term) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Negative Binomial Regression Predicting Citations (IRR)") |> 
  cols_label(term = "Predictor") |> 
  tab_source_note(source_note = "*** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05. Controls include Year and Macro-area.") |> 
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")), locations = cells_body(rows = term %in% c("n", "AIC", "BIC"))) |> 
  tab_style(style = cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "black", weight = px(2)), locations = cells_body(rows = term == "n")) |> 
  tab_options(table.font.size = 10, heading.title.font.size = 12, column_labels.font.weight = "bold") |> 
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -term)

table_4_3_4
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-citation-trends-leadership
#| fig.cap: "Mean Year-Normalized Citation Score (MNCS) by leadership (2000-2024). A value of 1.0 represents the dataset average for that year."
#| warning: false

# 1. Calculate Annual Baselines & Normalize
# We calculate the average citations for *all* core papers in each year
citation_norm_data <- data_core |> 
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2024) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  mutate(
    # Calculate average citations for this specific year (the "baseline")
    year_avg = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Normalize: Paper Citations / Year Average
    # 1.0 = Average, 2.0 = Twice the average, etc.
    cited_norm = cited / year_avg
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

# 2. Summarize by Leadership Group
citation_trends_norm <- citation_norm_data |> 
  filter(leadership_label %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led")) |> 
  group_by(year, leadership_label) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_norm_score = mean(cited_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Plot
ggplot(citation_trends_norm, aes(x = year, y = mean_norm_score, color = leadership_label)) +
  # Reference line at 1.0 (The "Average" paper)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 2000, y = 1.05, label = "Year Average (1.0)", 
           hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "gray50") +

  # Trend lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("VN-led" = "#0173B2", "JP-led" = "#DE8F05"),
    name = "Leadership"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Mean Normalized Citation Score") +
  
  # Styling
  labs(
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-predicted-citations-interaction
#| fig.cap: "Predicted citations by Leadership and Funding Status (Interaction Plot). Estimates are based on Model 4, holding other covariates at their means/reference levels."
#| warning: false

# 1. Create Prediction Grid
# We want to compare VN-led vs JP-led across Funded vs Unfunded
# holding other variables constant at "typical" values.
pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  leadership = c("VN-led", "JP-led"),
  is_funded = c(0, 1)
) |> 
  mutate(
    # Set the actual regression variables based on the grid labels
    vn_led = if_else(leadership == "VN-led", 1, 0),
    jp_led = if_else(leadership == "JP-led", 1, 0),
    
    # Set controls to reference/mean values
    year_num = median(reg_data$year_num, na.rm = TRUE), # Median year
    macro_area = "Physical Sciences",                   # Reference discipline
    is_multilateral = 0,                                # Bilateral (reference)
    prop_vn_centered = 0,                               # Mean proportion
    is_Q1 = 0,                                          # Not Q1 (conservative)
    is_OA = 0                                           # Not OA
  )

# 2. Predict Values (Link scale -> Response scale)
preds <- predict(m4, newdata = pred_grid, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

# 3. Calculate CIs and Back-transform
plot_data <- pred_grid |> 
  mutate(
    fit_link = preds$fit,
    se_link = preds$se.fit,
    # Calculate 95% CI on link scale
    lower_link = fit_link - 1.96 * se_link,
    upper_link = fit_link + 1.96 * se_link,
    # Exponentiate to get counts (Response scale)
    predicted_citations = exp(fit_link),
    ci_lower = exp(lower_link),
    ci_upper = exp(upper_link),
    
    # Factorize for plotting
    Funding_Status = factor(is_funded, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Unfunded", "Funded"))
  )

# 4. Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Funding_Status, y = predicted_citations, group = leadership, color = leadership)) +
  # Error Bars
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.05)) +
  
  # Lines connecting the points (The Interaction)
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(0.05)) +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.05)) +
  
  # Annotations (Optional: arrows or text if interaction is significant)
  # This depends on your specific model results, but often useful to highlight the slope difference
  
  # Scales
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("VN-led" = "#0173B2", "JP-led" = "#DE8F05"),
    name = "Leadership"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Predicted Citations (95% CI)") +
  
  # Theme & Labels
  labs(
    x = "Funding Status"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-vn-led-irr-time
#| fig.cap: "Evolution of the VN-led citation gap (IRR) over time (2000-2024). The shading represents the 95% confidence interval."
#| warning: false

yrs <- 0:24
beta_vn <- coef(m4)["vn_led"]
beta_int <- coef(m4)["vn_led:year_num"]
v <- vcov(m4)
se_trend <- sqrt(v["vn_led", "vn_led"] + 
                 (yrs^2) * v["vn_led:year_num", "vn_led:year_num"] + 
                 2 * yrs * v["vn_led", "vn_led:year_num"])

tibble(
  year = 2000 + yrs,
  log_irr = beta_vn + beta_int * yrs,
  se = se_trend
) |> 
  mutate(
    irr = exp(log_irr),
    lower = exp(log_irr - 1.96 * se),
    upper = exp(log_irr + 1.96 * se)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = irr)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, fill = "#0173B2") +
  geom_line(color = "#0173B2", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Incidence Rate Ratio (IRR)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: table-robustness-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# 1. Define Formulas
f_main <- cited ~ vn_led + jp_led + year_num + macro_area + is_multilateral + prop_vn_centered + is_funded + is_Q1 + is_OA + vn_led:is_funded + vn_led:is_Q1 + vn_led:year_num
f_bilateral <- cited ~ vn_led + jp_led + year_num + macro_area + prop_vn_centered + is_funded + is_Q1 + is_OA + vn_led:is_funded + vn_led:is_Q1 + vn_led:year_num
f_ols <- log(cited + 1) ~ vn_led + jp_led + year_num + macro_area + is_multilateral + prop_vn_centered + is_funded + is_Q1 + is_OA + vn_led:is_funded + vn_led:is_Q1 + vn_led:year_num

# 2. Fit Models
# M4: Main NB Model (Already fitted, refitting for clarity)
m_main <- glm.nb(f_main, data = reg_data)

# R1: Log-OLS (Linear Model on log citations)
m_ols <- lm(f_ols, data = reg_data)

# R2: Bilateral Only (Subset, removing is_multilateral)
data_bilateral <- reg_data |> filter(collab_mode == "Bilateral")
m_bilateral <- glm.nb(f_bilateral, data = data_bilateral)

# R3: Recent Period (2015-2024)
data_recent <- reg_data |> filter(year >= 2015)
m_recent <- glm.nb(f_main, data = data_recent)

# 3. Extraction Function
extract_robustness <- function(model, name, type = "NB") {
  # Coefficients
  coefs <- tidy(model, conf.int = FALSE) |> 
    filter(term %in% c("vn_led", "is_funded", "is_Q1", "vn_led:is_funded", "vn_led:is_Q1")) |> 
    mutate(
      stars = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        p.value < 0.1 ~ ".",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      # Format estimate with stars
      formatted = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", estimate), stars)
    ) |> 
    dplyr::select(term, formatted) |> 
    rename(!!name := formatted)
  
  # Fit Stats
  n_obs <- format(nobs(model), big.mark = ",")
  fit_stat <- if (type == "OLS") {
    sprintf("%.3f (R²)", summary(model)$adj.r.squared)
  } else {
    format(round(AIC(model)), big.mark = ",")
  }
  
  stats <- tibble(
    term = c("n", "Fit_Stat"),
    formatted = c(n_obs, fit_stat)
  ) |> 
    rename(!!name := formatted)
  
  bind_rows(coefs, stats)
}

# 4. Combine Results
res_main <- extract_robustness(m_main, "Main Model (M4-NB)", "NB")
res_r1 <- extract_robustness(m_ols, "R1 (Log-OLS)", "OLS")
res_r2 <- extract_robustness(m_bilateral, "R2 (Bilateral Only)", "NB")
res_r3 <- extract_robustness(m_recent, "R3 (Recent 2015+)", "NB")

rob_table <- res_main |> 
  full_join(res_r1, by = "term") |> 
  full_join(res_r2, by = "term") |> 
  full_join(res_r3, by = "term")

# 5. Generate GT Table
term_labels <- c(
  "vn_led" = "VN-led",
  "is_funded" = "Funded",
  "is_Q1" = "Q1 Journal",
  "vn_led:is_funded" = "VN-led × Funded",
  "vn_led:is_Q1" = "VN-led × Q1",
  "n" = "Observations",
  "Fit_Stat" = "AIC / Adj. R²"
)

table_5_2_1 <- rob_table |> 
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = names(term_labels), labels = term_labels)) |> 
  arrange(term) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(
    title = "Robustness Checks for Impact Parity Models"
  ) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(rows = term %in% c("Observations", "AIC / Adj. R²"))
  ) |> 
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "black", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_body(rows = term == "Observations")
  ) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    heading.title.font.size = 12,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  ) |> 
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -term)

table_5_2_1
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-appendix-c-diagnostics
#| fig.cap: "Diagnostic plots for the main model (M4). Quantile residuals are used in C.1 and C.2 to assess goodness-of-fit for the negative binomial distribution."
#| fig.width: 10
#| fig.height: 8
#| warning: false

library(statmod)
library(patchwork)

diag_data <- tibble(
  obs = 1:nobs(m4),
  fitted = fitted(m4),
  q_resid = qresiduals(m4),
  std_resid = rstandard(m4),
  cooks = cooks.distance(m4)
)

# C.1: Residuals vs. Fitted (using Quantile Residuals to avoid discreteness artifacts)
p1 <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = fitted, y = q_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "#0173B2") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#DE8F05", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure C.1: Residuals vs. Fitted",
    x = "Fitted Values",
    y = "Quantile Residuals"
  )

# C.2: Q-Q Plot (Quantile Residuals)
p2 <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(sample = q_resid)) +
  stat_qq(color = "#0173B2", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure C.2: Q-Q Plot",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  )

# C.3: Cook's Distance Plot
p3 <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = obs, y = cooks)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = obs, yend = 0), color = "#0173B2", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "#0173B2", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 4 / nobs(m4), linetype = "dashed", color = "#DE8F05") +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 4 / nobs(m4), label = "4/n threshold", 
           vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0, color = "#DE8F05", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure C.3: Cook's Distance",
    x = "Observation Index",
    y = "Cook's Distance"
  )

# C.4: Scale-Location Plot
p4 <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = fitted, y = sqrt(abs(std_resid)))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "#0173B2") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#DE8F05", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure C.4: Scale-Location",
    x = "Fitted Values",
    y = "√|Standardized Residuals|"
  )

(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4)
```

```{r}
#| label: table-leadership-balance-characteristics
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# 1. Prepare Data with necessary columns
df_char <- dat_reg |>
  mutate(
    n_authors = str_count(affiliations, ";") + 1,
    is_hyperauthored = n_authors > 50 | n_countries > 10,
    collab_mode_row = case_when(
      is_hyperauthored ~ "Hyperauthored",
      coop == "bilateral" ~ "Bilateral",
      TRUE ~ "Multilateral"
    ),
    leadership_label = case_when(
      vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
      jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
      TRUE ~ "Other-led"
    ),
    leadership_label = factor(leadership_label, levels = c("VN-led", "JP-led", "Other-led"))
  )

# 2. Function to Generate Summary Table
generate_char_table <- function(data, group_var, title_text) {
  
  # Calculate Totals for Share of Sample
  total_n <- nrow(data)
  
  table_data <- data |>
    filter(!is.na({{ group_var }})) |>
    group_by({{ group_var }}) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      Share_of_sample = n() / total_n,
      
      Mean_Authors = mean(n_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Countries = mean(n_countries, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Citations = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median_Citations = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Q4 = mean(quartile == "Q4", na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = mean(quartile == "Q3", na.rm = TRUE),
      Q2 = mean(quartile == "Q2", na.rm = TRUE),
      Q1 = mean(quartile == "Q1", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      OA_Rate = mean(OA == "OA", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      JP_Funded = mean(jap == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      VN_Funded = mean(vn == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Other_Funded = mean(fund == "Funded" & jap == 0 & vn == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Academia = mean(uni == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Public = mean(pub == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Industry = mean(ind == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Life_Sciences = mean(LS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Physical_Sciences = mean(PS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Health_Sciences = mean(HS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Social_Sciences = mean(SS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Bilateral = mean(collab_mode_row == "Bilateral", na.rm = TRUE),
      Multilateral = mean(collab_mode_row == "Multilateral", na.rm = TRUE),
      Hyperauthored = mean(collab_mode_row == "Hyperauthored", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -{{ group_var }}, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = {{ group_var }}, values_from = Value)
  
  # Define Row Groups
  row_groups <- tibble(
    Metric = c("n", "Share_of_sample", "Mean_Authors", "Mean_Countries", "Mean_Citations", "Median_Citations",
               "Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1", 
               "OA_Rate",
               "JP_Funded", "VN_Funded", "Other_Funded",
               "Academia", "Public", "Industry",
               "Life_Sciences", "Physical_Sciences", "Health_Sciences", "Social_Sciences",
               "Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored"),
    Section = c(rep("Characteristics", 6), 
                rep("Journal Quality", 4), 
                "Open Access",
                rep("Funding Sources", 3), 
                rep("Funding Sectors", 3), 
                rep("Disciplinary", 4),
                rep("Collaboration Mode", 3)),
    Label = c("n", "Share of sample", "Mean authors", "Mean countries", "Mean citations", "Median citations",
              "Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1", 
              "OA rate",
              "JP funded", "VN funded", "Other",
              "Academia", "Public", "Industry",
              "Life Sciences", "Physical Sciences", "Health Sciences", "Social Sciences",
              "Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored")
  )
  
  # Generate GT
  table_data |>
    left_join(row_groups, by = "Metric") |>
    # Ensure correct row order
    mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = row_groups$Metric)) |>
    arrange(Metric) |>
    group_by(Section) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "Label") |>
    cols_hide(columns = "Metric") |>
    fmt_integer(rows = Metric == "n") |>
    fmt_number(rows = Metric %in% c("Mean_Authors", "Mean_Countries", "Mean_Citations", "Median_Citations"), decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_percent(rows = !Metric %in% c("n", "Mean_Authors", "Mean_Countries", "Mean_Citations", "Median_Citations"), decimals = 1) |>
    tab_header(title = title_text) |>
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = 10, 
      heading.title.font.size = 12, 
      row_group.font.weight = "bold",
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
    )
}

# 3. Create Table 1: Leadership
table_leadership_char <- generate_char_table(df_char, leadership_label, "Characteristics by Leadership")

# 4. Create Table 2: Collaboration Balance (Filter out NA/Other if needed, or keep all)
# Assuming 'collab_type' is the variable for VN-dominated, JP-dominated, Balanced
table_balance_char <- generate_char_table(
  df_char |> filter(collab_type %in% c("VN-dominated", "JP-dominated", "Balanced")), 
  collab_type, 
  "Characteristics by Collaboration Balance"
)

# Display
table_leadership_char
table_balance_char
```
